scenario.summary: CL-UNK-1211 is an AI-assisted campaign targeting government Linux infrastructure to exfiltrate mailboxes and sensitive databases. The attackers utilize custom Go-based backdoors (SysGoRAT), extensive web shell deployments, and creative credential theft such as hijacking the sudo command through .bashrc modifications.

hunt.name: Linux Persistence and Credential Hijacking
hunt.description: The adversary uses AI-assisted code to modify PHP configuration directories and .bashrc profiles, ensuring that malicious code executes whenever a web request is processed or a user elevates privileges. This hunt targets the activity of CL-UNK-1211, focusing on the specialized Linux persistence and credential theft observed in their campaign. The hunt identifies the web server estate and executes parallel checks: one to find anomalous shell execution originating from web server process managers, and another to baseline rare file modifications across critical configuration paths. The analyst evaluates the results to differentiate legitimate administrative activity from AI-automated intrusion artifacts.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, user_name, process_name, process_cmd_line, parent_process_name, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (LOWER(parent_process_name) LIKE '%php-fpm%' OR LOWER(parent_process_name) LIKE '%httpd%' OR LOWER(parent_process_name) LIKE '%nginx%' OR LOWER(parent_process_name) LIKE '%apache%') AND (LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%bash%' OR LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%sh%' OR LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%nc%' OR LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%python%' OR LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%perl%' OR LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%php%') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Identify the primary behavioral signature of a web shell: a web server process manager spawning an interactive shell or interpreter.
config.expected_signal: Web server child processes that are shell interpreters. User name 'www-data' or similar indicates web shell context; 'root' indicates successful privilege escalation.

nodes.label: Rare modifications to configurations and profiles

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, actor_user_name, file_path, time FROM hb_file_activity WHERE (LOWER(file_path) LIKE '%/etc/php/%' OR LOWER(file_path) LIKE '%/opt/plesk/php/%' OR LOWER(file_path) LIKE '%/.bashrc' OR instr(',' || '{{known_malicious_files}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(file_name) || ',') > 0) AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND file_path IN (SELECT file_path FROM hb_file_activity WHERE (LOWER(file_path) LIKE '%/etc/php/%' OR LOWER(file_path) LIKE '%/opt/plesk/php/%' OR LOWER(file_path) LIKE '%/.bashrc' OR instr(',' || '{{known_malicious_files}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(file_name) || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY file_path HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) <= 5) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Identify modifications to PHP configuration directories and shell profiles that are rare across the fleet, suggesting targeted tampering.
config.expected_signal: Rare file modifications in critical paths. The presence of deceptive names like Solarwinds.StatusLog.txt or plesk_sys_driver.php on specific hosts is a strong indicator of the CL-UNK-1211 playbook.
